title: Choose the visual world for Muse Skills
question: The roll assigned Skill Facts Panel. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Skill Facts Panel
options.lineage: OTC pharmacy packaging and the regulated Facts panel
options.thesis: Every skill is a boxed product with a Facts panel: Uses, Warnings, Directions, Ingredients. The install prompt is the Directions block.
options.viewport: Left: a monumental product name and one-line offer over a saturated box-front field. Right: the featured skill's full Facts panel at print scale, Directions block open, one Copy install prompt button inside it. Below: the aisle, a shelf of category-colored boxes, and the search field.
options.risk: Reads as a gag if the panel is a costume; it works only if the panel is the real page structure and the copy stays literal and sober.

raised.raise: One fixed column measure for every panel, phone to desktop; the panel scales its cell, never reflows into cards.
Entry type (skill, prompt, workflow, config) is carried by a drawn mark and a word, never by color alone.
Display type set at physical carton scale: the product name is the largest ink on the page and behaves like printed matter, not a web heading.
The install flow has three named phases (Copy, Paste, Confirm) rendered as discrete labeled states, so progress is legible without color.
Color commits at region scale: a box-front field owns its whole area; no accent scattered over white.

options.label: Patch Library
options.lineage: synth patch sheets and hardware preset banks
options.thesis: Each skill is a patch: a numbered slot, a patch sheet showing what is wired to what, and one Load button.
options.viewport: A bank of numbered patch slots across the top; the selected patch's sheet fills the page with its routing and a Load patch action.
options.risk: The most familiar of the grounded list for a tinkerer audience, and it can read as a music product to everyone else.

options.label: Copy-Shop Zine
options.lineage: photocopied zine interiors on colored copy stock
options.thesis: Every skill is a typed sheet on its own colored stock, passed hand to hand.
options.viewport: One goldenrod sheet square to the frame, the featured skill typed down it, neighbors visible as strips of stock at the edges.
options.case: Community sharing is its native subject, so identification is strong; the single typed column loses on clarity for a scannable directory.
options.risk: Reads as nostalgia when the copier filter does the work the structure should.

options.label: Teletext Service
options.thesis: The directory as a broadcast index: three-digit pages, not sections.
options.viewport: P100 index, skills as numbered rows.
options.case: Muse's audience does not identify with teletext, and the 40-cell grid fights long install prompts.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every skill tied to its default by an amber link line.
options.case: An Operate grammar for a Persuade surface; state vocabulary the directory does not need.
options.kept: State by drawn mark, never color alone.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.case: No product clarity for a directory; the mechanism is one paste, not language physics.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.thesis: Content in horizon bands from night to day.
options.case: Atmosphere with no directory topology; readers cannot find a skill by dawn phase.

options.label: Mezzotint Night
options.viewport: A dark plate with one lit passage.
options.case: Fine-art gravity a consumer skills directory cannot carry; long source blocks on velvet black lose legibility.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The directory grid grokbot.dev and every prompt library ship: search hero, card grid, detail page with a code block.
canonCard.viewport: Search bar over a card grid grouped by category.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
